full_text:
A shepherd driving his flock into the sheepfold grew impatient when the sheep clustered at the narrow gate. He began shouting harshly, throwing stones, and setting his fierce dog upon the gentle creatures, tearing their soft fleeces.

An elderly bell-wether paused in the gateway, turned his curling horns toward the shepherd, and spoke with gentle dignity:

"Why do you treat us so roughly, master? We yield you rich milk to drink every morning; we surrender our soft wool each spring to keep you warm through winter storms; and we follow your pipe across the hills without complaint. If you treat those who give you everything with violence, how will you treat your enemies?"

Ashamed of his harsh temper, the shepherd called off his hound and guided the gentle flock with patient care.
moral: Those who yield their gifts peacefully deserve gentle and patient treatment.
